title: Produce substantial fat loss while preserving skeletal muscle and strength

concept.text: Improve the composition and functional consequences of drug-induced weight loss by preserving muscle. BELIEVE demonstrated substantially less DXA lean-mass loss with bimagrumab plus semaglutide; preservation of clinically important muscle function still needs decisive validation. Proposed completion test: Regulatory approval of a muscle-preservation claim after a randomized trial of at least 500 adults over at least 52 weeks, showing ≥15% mean weight loss, ≥90% of lost weight attributable to fat, and prespecified preservation of MRI-measured muscle and strength against clinically justified noninferiority margins. Test set by: Proposed editorial test; regulators would determine the acceptable indication and functional endpoints. BELIEVE's composition endpoints are trial milestones, not an accepted regulatory definition of muscle preservation. Overlaps: END-05, ORT-06. Sources given: [BELIEVE randomized phase 2 publication](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04204-0.pdf) ; [Scholar Rock November 2026 programme and regulatory update](https://scholarrock.gcs-web.com/static-files/d095bef0-0511-454b-ad49-13d8ef6afbee).

page.title: Drug-induced fat loss with muscle and strength preservation
page.definition: A drug or drug combination reduces body fat in people with obesity while preserving skeletal muscle mass and strength. Total lean mass measured by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry includes muscle and other tissues. Muscle imaging can track changes in muscle size, and a separate measurement, such as the force exerted during knee extension, tests whether strength is preserved.

goal.need: Obesity affects up to one-third of older adults worldwide. For someone who already has little muscle strength, further loss can make daily activities harder to manage independently. In a 40-week trial of tirzepatide, two groups lost similar amounts of weight. Strength fell with usual activity and rose with resistance training three times a week, although both groups lost lean tissue. A drug that preserves muscle during fat loss could help people stay independent if the muscle retained also sustains physical function.

completion.title: FDA approves an obesity treatment with explicit skeletal-muscle and strength-preservation claims.
completion.criterion: FDA grants marketing approval for a drug or drug combination whose approved labeling explicitly establishes fat reduction with preservation of skeletal muscle mass and strength in the indicated population. Evidence supports the muscle and strength claims alongside weight-management efficacy and safety. Numerical efficacy thresholds, functional endpoints and acceptable preservation margins are those accepted by FDA for that indication.
completion.set_by: Technology Atlas fallback; no published combined numerical completion test was located.
completion.basis: FDA and EMA weight-management guidance, EASO recommendations and Veru's disclosures of FDA feedback were searched for a combined fat-loss, muscle-mass and strength-preservation test. None was found. FDA places body-composition efficacy claims outside its draft's scope. Approval with explicit muscle and strength claims provides a verifiable fallback without assigning numerical efficacy or noninferiority margins.

milestones.title: An adjunct reduces lean-mass loss in obese mice receiving a GLP-1 receptor agonist.
milestones.criterion: In mice with diet-induced obesity, compare change from baseline in lean mass by quantitative nuclear magnetic resonance. Mice receiving the adjunct plus a GLP-1 receptor agonist lose less lean mass than mice receiving the same agonist and a control antibody.
milestones.set_by: Scholar Rock, published comparative mouse experiment presented at Keystone Symposia on 5 February 2024; an experimental efficacy test.
milestones.threshold_quote: SRK-439 diminished the GLP-1 RA-driven lean mass loss

milestones.title: An investigational new drug application takes effect for the proposed obesity trial.
milestones.criterion: An investigational new drug application covering the proposed human study takes effect 30 days after FDA receives it unless FDA imposes a clinical hold, or earlier if FDA notifies the sponsor that the clinical investigation may begin.
milestones.set_by: US Food and Drug Administration, 21 CFR 312.40(b).
milestones.threshold_quote: Thirty days after FDA receives the IND, unless FDA notifies the sponsor that the investigations described in the IND are subject to a clinical hold

milestones.title: Human dosing establishes tolerability and drug exposure sufficient for phase 2 testing.
milestones.criterion: Human dosing characterizes drug exposure, pharmacological effects and adverse effects across doses well enough to design a controlled phase 2 study.
milestones.set_by: US Food and Drug Administration, Drug Development and Review Definitions, Phase I Clinical Studies.
milestones.threshold_quote: permit the design of well-controlled, scientifically valid, Phase 2 studies.

milestones.title: A trial reports the proportion losing ≥10% of fat mass with <5% lean-mass loss at 48 weeks.
milestones.criterion: For each participant, compare total fat mass and lean mass by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry at baseline and week 48. Count a responder when fat mass falls by at least 10% and lean mass falls by less than 5%, stays stable or increases. Report the responder percentage by treatment group. The protocol specifies no minimum percentage of responders.
milestones.set_by: Versanis Bio, BELIEVE protocol version 5.0, Table 1, secondary body-composition endpoints.
milestones.threshold_quote: Fat mass ≥ 10% with <5% decrease (or an increase) in lean mass by DXA

milestones.title: An adjunct reduces the proportion of adults losing ≥10% stair-climb power at 16 weeks.
milestones.criterion: In adults aged 60 years or older receiving semaglutide, compare the proportion whose stair-climb power declines by at least 10% from baseline to week 16 with enobosarm versus placebo. The adjunct group must have a smaller proportion under that responder definition.
milestones.set_by: Veru, exploratory QUALITY responder comparison reported in its Form 10-Q. The treatment-group comparison uses “at least 10%”; the preceding description uses “greater than 10%.”
milestones.threshold_quote: subjects that lost at least 10% stair climb power

milestones.title: Confirmatory trials support labeling for fat loss with preservation of skeletal muscle and strength.
milestones.criterion: Phase 3 studies in the intended population provide the effectiveness and safety evidence needed to assess the regimen’s overall benefit and risk and support the proposed labeling. For a body-composition claim, the clinical condition and endpoints measuring patient benefit are addressed with FDA during development.
milestones.set_by: US Food and Drug Administration, Drug Development and Review Definitions, Phase 3 Clinical Studies, together with its January 2025 draft weight-reduction guidance.
milestones.threshold_quote: needed to evaluate the overall benefit-risk relationship of the drug.

milestones.title: A 12-week human study measures fat mass, thigh muscle size and knee-extension strength together.
milestones.criterion: In the same adults receiving semaglutide, measure fat mass, ultrasound cross-sectional area of the vastus lateralis and maximal voluntary isometric knee-extension strength at baseline and after 12 weeks. Report absolute muscle size and strength so that weight loss itself cannot improve the measures by reducing their denominator.
milestones.set_by: Investigators of NCT05606471, published muscle assessments in the 12-week semaglutide study of adults with type 2 diabetes and a body mass index of 27–50 kg/m².
milestones.threshold_quote: we tested changes in BW, LBM, muscle mass, and muscle strength before and after treatment with GLP-1RA.

milestones.title: A randomized trial compares change in thigh muscle volume by MRI through 52 weeks.
milestones.criterion: In adults with obesity receiving semaglutide, compare trevogrumab with placebo using MRI at baseline, week 26 and week 52. Quantify change in the fat-free muscle volume of both thighs within each group. The exploratory substudy specifies the tissue, comparison and visits without defining a minimum clinically important difference.
milestones.set_by: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, COURAGE part B prespecified exploratory MRI substudy, protocol R1033-OB-2288.
milestones.threshold_quote: at baseline, week 26, and week 52 to quantify bilateral thigh fat-free muscle volume (FFMV) over time.

milestones.title: FDA accepts for review an obesity application seeking both muscle- and strength-preservation claims.
milestones.criterion: FDA accepts for substantive review a new drug application or biologics license application seeking labeling for fat reduction with preservation of skeletal muscle mass and strength in the proposed obesity population.
milestones.set_by: US Food and Drug Administration, Center for Drug Evaluation and Research, filing determination for new drug and biologics license applications.
milestones.threshold_quote: the application is sufficiently complete to permit a substantive review.

not_found: No FDA, EMA or society document located defines a combined numerical threshold for fat loss, skeletal-muscle preservation and strength preservation.
No publicly available FDA feedback letter was found to independently verify Veru's account of its indication-specific regulatory advice.
No qualifying confirmatory obesity result or approved muscle-and-strength-preservation claim was located as of 15 November 2026.
No public QUALITY protocol or statistical analysis plan was located that prespecifies how a 10% decline in stair-climb power is classified.

results.finding: In 66 healthy adults, single and multiple apitegromab doses up to 30 mg/kg were tolerated and produced sustained target engagement.
results.detail: The study characterized pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics and informed phase 2 dosing for spinal muscular atrophy. It did not assess muscle preservation during obesity treatment.
results.quote: Single and multiple apitegromab doses resulted in dose-dependent and sustained increases in serum latent myostatin, indicating robust target engagement.

results.finding: In diet-induced obese mice, bimagrumab plus semaglutide (n=8) preserved lean mass versus about 10% loss with semaglutide plus control IgG1 (n=9).
results.detail: Figure 1F–G reports absolute and percentage changes in lean mass from baseline.
results.quote: Combination treatment with bimagrumab and semaglutide led to superior fat mass loss while simultaneously preserving lean mass despite reduced food intake.

results.finding: In a phase 1 study of 66 healthy adults, single and repeated intravenous apitegromab doses were well tolerated up to 30 mg/kg.
results.quote: Single and multiple ascending doses of apitegromab were safe and well tolerated at doses up to 30 mg/kg in healthy subjects.

results.finding: Adults with overweight or obesity receiving bimagrumab plus semaglutide (n=43 analyzed) had a 42.06% adjusted mean reduction in DXA fat mass at week 48.
results.detail: The group mean cannot establish what percentage of participants met both thresholds.

results.finding: In 168 older adults on semaglutide, enobosarm 3 mg reduced the proportion losing at least 10% of stair-climb power by 59.8% relative to placebo.
results.detail: The filing introduces the cutoff as “greater than 10%” and describes the reported results for each arm as “at least 10%.” It gives total enrollment but omits the number analyzed in each arm.
results.quote: The all enobosarm 3mg + semaglutide group had a statistically significant and clinically meaningfully 59.8% relative reduction in the proportion of subjects that lost at least 10% stair climb power compared to placebo + semaglutide group (p=0.0006).

results.finding: Diet-induced obese male mice (n = 8 per arm in Fig. 1) gained lean mass with dual blockade plus semaglutide versus loss with semaglutide plus IgG4 (P < 0.05).
results.detail: Figure 1 lists 8 mice in the semaglutide plus control-antibody arm. The Methods list 7 for that arm. Both list 8 in the adjunct arm.

definition = "A drug or drug combination reduces body fat in people with obesity while preserving skeletal muscle mass and strength. Total lean mass measured by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry includes muscle and other tissues. Muscle imaging can track changes in muscle size, and a separate measurement, such as the force exerted during knee extension, tests whether strength is preserved.". Reason: The definition requires muscle-specific evidence but gives readers no way to distinguish a lean-mass result from evidence about muscle size or strength.

goal.need = "Obesity affects up to one-third of older adults worldwide. For someone who already has little muscle strength, further loss can make daily activities harder to manage independently. In a 40-week trial of tirzepatide, two groups lost similar amounts of weight. Strength fell with usual activity and rose with resistance training three times a week, although both groups lost lean tissue. A drug that preserves muscle during fat loss could help people stay independent if the muscle retained also sustains physical function.". Reason: The current rationale gives a tissue percentage and a society recommendation but omits the people at risk, the practical benefit and what resistance training already achieves.
